steps.name: Check pnpm-lock.yaml

steps.name: Check .nvmrc matches the Dockerfile Node version
steps.run:
nvmrc=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)
dockerfile=$(sed -nE 's/^FROM node:([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+).*/\1/p' Dockerfile | head -n 1)
if [ "$nvmrc" != "$dockerfile" ]; then
  echo "::error file=.nvmrc::.nvmrc is ${nvmrc} but the Dockerfile base image is node:${dockerfile:-<not found>}. Update both together."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Check if we should build this platform
steps.run:
if [[ "${{ matrix.platform }}" == "linux/arm64" ]] && [[ "${{ github.ref }}" != "refs/heads/main" ]] && [[ ! "${{ github.ref }}" =~ ^refs/tags/v ]]; then
  echo "skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "Skipping arm64 build (only built on main and tagged releases)"
else
  echo "skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "Building for platform ${{ matrix.platform }}"
fi

steps.name: Add route to GCP Load Balancer
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Get current config
gcloud compute url-maps export stg-activitypub --global --project ${GCP_PROJECT} > config.yml
# Delete unnecessary fields
yq -i 'del(.fingerprint)' config.yml
yq -i 'del(.creationTimestamp)' config.yml
export DEFAULT_SERVICE="https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/${GCP_PROJECT}/global/backendServices/stg-netherlands-activitypub-api"
export PR_SERVICE="https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/${GCP_PROJECT}/global/backendServices/stg-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-api"
# Add host rules and path matchers if they don't exist
yq -i '.hostRules = (.hostRules // [{"hosts": ["activitypub.ghostinfra.net"], "pathMatcher": "all-paths"}])' config.yml
yq -i '.pathMatchers = (.pathMatchers // [{"name": "all-paths", "defaultService": "'"$DEFAULT_SERVICE"'", "routeRules": []}])' config.yml
# Remove existing route rules for the PR service
yq -i '.pathMatchers[] |= (.routeRules |= map(select((.routeAction.weightedBackendServices // []) | length == 0 or .routeAction.weightedBackendServices[0].backendService != env(PR_SERVICE))))' config.yml
# Add new route rules for the PR service
export MIN_PRIORITY=$(yq '[.pathMatchers[] | select(.name == "all-paths") | .routeRules[]?.priority] | min // 0' config.yml)
export NEXT_PRIORITY=$((MIN_PRIORITY - 1))
LABELS_JSON=$(echo "$LABELS" | jq -c '[.[] | select(.name | test("\\.ghost\\.is$")) | .name]')
for LABEL in $(echo "$LABELS_JSON" | jq -r '.[]'); do
  echo "Adding route for label: $LABEL"
  yq -i '.pathMatchers[0].routeRules = [{"priority": '${NEXT_PRIORITY}', "matchRules": [{"prefixMatch": "/", "headerMatches": [{"headerName": "X-Forwarded-Host", "exactMatch": "'"${LABEL}"'"}]}], "routeAction": {"weightedBackendServices": [{"backendService": "'"${PR_SERVICE}"'", "weight": 100}]}, "headerAction": {"requestHeadersToAdd": [{"headerName": "X-ActivityPub-PR", "headerValue": "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"}, {"headerName": "X-ActivityPub-Commit", "headerValue": "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"}]}}] + .pathMatchers[0].routeRules' config.yml
  export NEXT_PRIORITY=$((NEXT_PRIORITY + 1))
done
echo "Updating url map with:"
cat config.yml
gcloud compute url-maps import stg-activitypub --source=config.yml --global --project ${GCP_PROJECT} --quiet

pipelines.name: Ephemeral Staging Tear Down

steps.name: Check Closed PRs Deployed
steps.run:
export destroy_prs=""
for PR_NUMBER in $(gcloud run services list --project ${GCP_PROJECT} --format=json \
  | jq -r '.[] | select(.metadata.name | test("stg-pr-\\d+-api")) | .metadata.name | capture("stg-pr-(?<num>\\d+)-api") | .num'); do
  # For scheduled runs, teardown all PRs
  if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "schedule" ]; then
    echo "Scheduled run: Deleting PR $PR_NUMBER environment."
    export destroy_prs="$destroy_prs $PR_NUMBER"
  else
    # For other triggers, only teardown closed/merged PRs
    PR_STATE=$(gh pr view $PR_NUMBER --json state | jq -r '.state')
    echo "PR $PR_NUMBER state is $PR_STATE."
    if [ "$PR_STATE" == "MERGED" ] || [ "$PR_STATE" == "CLOSED" ]; then
      echo "Deleting PR $PR_NUMBER environment."
      export destroy_prs="$destroy_prs $PR_NUMBER"
    fi
  fi
done
echo "destroy_prs=$destroy_prs" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Get terraform version
steps.run: echo "terraform_version=$(cat activitypub-infra/infrastructure/activitypub-staging-environments/.terraform-version)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Change github.com url in modules to local directories and add backend prefix
steps.run:
cd activitypub-infra/infrastructure/activitypub-staging-environments
sed -i 's/github\.com\/TryGhost/\.\.\/\.\.\/\.\./gI' main.tf
sed -i 's/\?ref=main//g' main.tf

steps.name: Destroy Tests databases
steps.run:
for PR_NUMBER in ${DESTROY_PRS}; do
  TEST_DATABASES=$(gcloud sql databases list --instance=stg-netherlands-activitypub --filter="name~pr_${PR_NUMBER}_test*" --format="value(name)" --project ${GCP_PROJECT})
  for TEST_DATABASE in ${TEST_DATABASES}; do
    gcloud sql databases delete ${TEST_DATABASE} --instance=stg-netherlands-activitypub --quiet --project ${GCP_PROJECT}
  done
done

steps.name: Remove route from GCP Load Balancer
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for PR_NUMBER in ${DESTROY_PRS}; do
  # Get current config
  gcloud compute url-maps export stg-activitypub --global --project ${GCP_PROJECT} > config.yml
  # Delete unnecessary fields
  yq -i 'del(.fingerprint)' config.yml
  yq -i 'del(.creationTimestamp)' config.yml
  export PR_SERVICE="https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/ghost-activitypub/global/backendServices/stg-pr-${PR_NUMBER}-api"
  # Remove existing route rules for the PR service
  yq -i '.pathMatchers[] |= (.routeRules |= map(select((.routeAction.weightedBackendServices // []) | length == 0 or .routeAction.weightedBackendServices[0].backendService != env(PR_SERVICE))))' config.yml
  echo "Updating url map with:"
  cat config.yml
  gcloud compute url-maps import stg-activitypub --source=config.yml --global --project ${GCP_PROJECT} --quiet
done

steps.name: Terraform destroy
steps.run:
cd activitypub-infra/infrastructure/activitypub-staging-environments
for PR_NUMBER in ${DESTROY_PRS}; do
  echo "Destroying PR $PR_NUMBER staging environment."
  git checkout -- terraform.tf
  sed -i 's/REPLACE_ME/'${PR_NUMBER}'/g' terraform.tf
  terraform init
  export TF_VAR_github_pr_number=$PR_NUMBER
  export TF_VAR_primary_region_name=netherlands
  export TF_VAR_migrations_image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/ghost-activitypub/activitypub/migrations:edge
  export TF_VAR_api_image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/ghost-activitypub/activitypub/activitypub:edge
  export TF_VAR_queue_image=europe-docker.pkg.dev/ghost-activitypub/activitypub/activitypub:edge
  terraform destroy -auto-approve
done

pipelines.name: Push

steps.name: Push ActivityPub Docker image to private registry
steps.run:
docker load < /tmp/activitypub-amd64.tar
echo "${{ inputs.activitypub-private-tags }}" | while read -r tag; do
  docker push $tag
done

steps.name: Push ActivityPub multi-arch image and manifest to public registry
steps.run:
source_private=$(printf '%s\n' "$PRIVATE_TAGS" | awk 'NF { print; exit }')
[ -n "$source_private" ] || { echo "no source tag"; exit 1; }

amd64_digest=""
while IFS= read -r tag; do
  [ -n "$tag" ] || continue
  docker tag "$source_private" "$tag"
  push_output=$(docker push "$tag")
  echo "$push_output"
  d=$(echo "$push_output" | grep -oE 'digest: sha256:[a-f0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}' | tail -1)
  [ -n "$d" ] && amd64_digest="$d"
done <<< "$PUBLIC_TAGS"
[ -n "$amd64_digest" ] || { echo "failed to capture amd64 digest"; exit 1; }

arm64_digest=$(cat /tmp/digests/activitypub-arm64.digest)
[ -n "$arm64_digest" ] || { echo "missing arm64 digest"; exit 1; }

tag_args=()
while IFS= read -r tag; do
  [ -n "$tag" ] || continue
  tag_args+=(-t "$tag")
done <<< "$PUBLIC_TAGS"

annotation_args=()
while IFS= read -r label; do
  [ -n "$label" ] || continue
  annotation_args+=(--annotation "index:$label")
done <<< "$PUBLIC_LABELS"

docker buildx imagetools create "${tag_args[@]}" "${annotation_args[@]}" \
  "ghcr.io/tryghost/activitypub@${amd64_digest}" \
  "ghcr.io/tryghost/activitypub@${arm64_digest}"
